Name: Confirm Totem
Author: emurphy42
Description:
Ever gone into Skull Cavern with a warp totem, then accidentally used it earlier than you meant to? This mod is for you.

Also covers rain totems, treasure totems, and "unknown" for other types that may be added by another mod.

Options:
[list]
[*][b]None[/b]: Use the totem immediately, no confirmation needed.
[*][b]Dialog[/b]: Yes/no confirmation (default yes).
[*][b]Warning[/b]: More intrusive yes/no confirmation (default no). This is the mod's default behavior.
[/list]
This assumes that any item with "Totem" is consumed on use. If you ever encounter an exception, then please report it under Posts or Bugs, and meanwhile set that type's option to None (or use CJB Item Spawner to get it back).
